prompt.en: I need slides on “Renewable energy sources”, in plain words.

items.label: Benefits
items.text: Clean air and a source that does not run out

uz.body:
Energiyaga ehtiyoj yil sayin ortib bormoqda
Ko‘mir va gaz zaxiralari cheklangan
Tabiat o‘zi beradigan manbalar tugamaydi

ru.body:

en.body:
The need for energy grows every year
Coal and gas reserves are limited
The sources nature gives do not run out

uz.body: Qayta tiklanuvchi energiya — tabiatda o‘z-o‘zidan tiklanadigan manbalardan olinadigan energiya.

ru.body: Возобновляемая энергия — энергия из источников, которые восстанавливаются в природе сами.

en.body: Renewable energy is energy from sources that renew themselves in nature.

items.label: Wind
items.text: Turbines take power from the wind

items.label: Water
items.text: A river’s flow turns a hydroelectric plant

en.body:
Solar panels on roofs
Solar water heaters
Small panels for street lights

A panel stores spare power in a battery
It works well with energy-saving lamps
